heading.en: Buying and selling: what did we make?
heading.kn: ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟ: ನಾವು ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಳಿಸಿದೆವು?

hook.en: A kirana store sells goods worth ₹2.3 lakh. How much of that is profit on trading, before rent and salaries? The trading account answers this.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ ₹2.3 ಲಕ್ಷದ ಸರಕು ಮಾರುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಾಡಿಗೆ, ಸಂಬಳಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಲಾಭ? ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಖಾತೆ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Calculate cost of goods sold and gross profit.

narration.en: A kirana store sells goods worth ₹2.3 lakh. How much of that is profit on trading, before rent and salaries? The trading account answers this.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ ₹2.3 ಲಕ್ಷದ ಸರಕು ಮಾರುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಾಡಿಗೆ, ಸಂಬಳಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಲಾಭ? ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಖಾತೆ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The trading account is prepared to find gross profit or gross loss from buying and selling. Debit side: opening stock, purchases less returns, and direct expenses such as wages, carriage inwards, freight, fuel and power, and import duty. Credit side: sales less returns, and closing stock. A credit balance is gross profit; a debit balance is gross loss.

points.en: Debit: opening stock, net purchases, direct expenses
Balance: gross profit or gross loss

narration.en: The trading account is prepared to find gross profit or gross loss from buying and selling. Debit side: opening stock, purchases less returns, and direct expenses such as wages, carriage inwards, freight, fuel and power, and import duty. Credit side: sales less returns, and closing stock. A credit balance is gross profit; a debit balance is gross loss.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ಒಟ್ಟು ನಷ್ಟ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ತಯಾರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು, ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು; ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು.

body.en: Cost of goods sold is the cost of the goods actually sold during the year. It is found by adding opening stock, net purchases and direct expenses, and deducting closing stock.

narration.en: Cost of goods sold is the cost of the goods actually sold during the year. It is found by adding opening stock, net purchases and direct expenses, and deducting closing stock.
narration.kn: ಮಾರಾಟವಾದ ಸರಕುಗಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಖರೀದಿ + ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು − ಅಂತಿಮ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು.

problem.en: Prepare the trading account of Sri Rama Traders: Opening stock ₹20,000; Purchases ₹1,50,000; Purchases returns ₹5,000; Wages ₹15,000; Carriage inwards ₹3,000; Sales ₹2,40,000; Sales returns ₹10,000; Closing stock ₹25,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Prepare the trading account of Sri Rama Traders: Opening stock ₹20,000; Purchases ₹1,50,000; Purchases returns ₹5,000; Wages ₹15,000; Carriage inwards ₹3,000; Sales ₹2,40,000; Sales returns ₹10,000; Closing stock ₹25,000.

heading.en: Direct to Trading, Indirect to P&L

body.en: Ask: "Was this spent to buy or make the goods?" Then it is direct and goes to the trading account (wages, carriage inwards, freight). "Was it spent to run the office or sell?" Then it is indirect and goes to profit and loss (salaries, rent, carriage outwards).

narration.en: Direct to Trading, Indirect to P&L. Ask: "Was this spent to buy or make the goods?" Then it is direct and goes to the trading account (wages, carriage inwards, freight). "Was it spent to run the office or sell?" Then it is indirect and goes to profit and loss (salaries, rent, carriage outwards).

mnemonic.en: IN-wards to trading, OUT-wards to P&L

points.en: The trading account finds gross profit or gross loss.
points.kn: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಖಾತೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Direct expenses such as wages and carriage inwards are debited to it.
points.kn: ಕೂಲಿ, ಒಳಸಾಗಣೆ ವೆಚ್ಚದಂತಹ ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ಇದರ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗೆ.

points.en: COGS = Opening stock + Net purchases + Direct expenses − Closing stock.
points.kn: ಮಾರಾಟವಾದ ಸರಕಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಖರೀದಿ + ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚ − ಅಂತಿಮ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು.
ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ = ನಿವ್ವಳ ಮಾರಾಟ − ಮಾರಾಟವಾದ ಸರಕಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ.

homework.en: Prepare a trading account with your own figures that shows a gross loss.

narration.en: Recap. The trading account finds gross profit or gross loss. Direct expenses such as wages and carriage inwards are debited to it. COGS = Opening stock + Net purchases + Direct expenses − Closing stock. Gross profit = Net sales − COGS.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಖಾತೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೂಲಿ, ಒಳಸಾಗಣೆ ವೆಚ್ಚದಂತಹ ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ಇದರ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗೆ. ಮಾರಾಟವಾದ ಸರಕಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಖರೀದಿ + ನೇರ ವೆಚ್ಚ − ಅಂತಿಮ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು. ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ = ನಿವ್ವಳ ಮಾರಾಟ − ಮಾರಾಟವಾದ ಸರಕಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ.
